model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: Tesla's Model Y specs: 'Overall Length: 188.6"' (Performance: 188.8"). Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-modely-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

cross_check.note: C/D 2026 Long Range Launch Series AWD

width_in.note: Tesla gives only mirror figures: 'Overall Width: Folded mirrors: 78.0" | Extended mirrors: 83.8"'. C/D's 83.8 in 'without mirrors' is Tesla's mirrors-extended figure. Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-modely-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

awd.label: AWD, Premium AWD, Performance
awd.note: Secondary source: C/D 2026 trim list. C/D review: 'Drivetrain: All-Wheel Drive, Rear-Wheel Drive'.

charge_port.note: Not fetched: tesla.com returned HTTP 403. C/D's review doesn't name the port.

supercharger_access.note: Tesla's Model Y page lists 'Supercharging Max/Payment Type: 250 kW Max; Pay Per Use' for every version. Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-modely-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Secondary source: C/D '2026 Tesla Model Y Review, Pricing, and Specs', ranked #5 in Best Electric Compact SUVs; also ranked by MotorTrend and Edmunds. C/D also lists a 2027 Model Y and a 2027 Model Y L submodel.

epa_range.note: Trim mapping from Tesla's Model Y page (Premium All-Wheel Drive 327 mi, Performance 306 mi, Premium Rear-Wheel Drive 357 mi). Excludes the long-wheelbase Model Y L, a different body that EPA doesn't list.

height_in.note: C/D 2026 Long Range Launch Series AWD, 'Height (inches)'.

cargo_cu_ft.note: C/D 2026 Long Range Launch Series AWD, cargo space behind the second row and behind the front row.

turning_circle_ft.note: C/D 2026 Long Range Launch Series AWD, 'Turning Diameter / Radius, curb to curb (feet)'.
